traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.text: Sonechard carries the war pick Fool’s Errand.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.text:
As a bonus action, Sonechard can move up to its speed
toward a hostile creature that it can see.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: Sonechard’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components. * At will: animate dead, chill touch (17th level), inflict wounds (5th level) * 3/day each: circle of death, create undead, fireball, finger of death, harm * 1/day: create undead (9th level)

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
traits.text:
If Sonechard fails a saving throw, it can
choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
Sonechard has advantage on saving throws against
spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Stench
traits.text:
Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of Sonechard
must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until
the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is
immune to Sonechard’s Stench for 24 hours.

traits.name: Unholy Aura
traits.text:
An unholy aura surrounds Sonechard out to a radius of
40 feet. A creature who enters or begins its turn in the area must make
a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the target is
frightened for 1 minute. While frightened, it is paralyzed. A frightened
target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending
the effect on a success.

traits.name: Undead Master
traits.text:
When Sonechard casts animate dead or create undead,
it creates twice the amount of undead with each casting.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
Sonechard makes two attacks with Fool’s Errand, one
claw attack, and one head butt, or two claw attacks and one head butt.

actions.name: Fool’s Errand
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d8 + 9) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Head Butt
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its
next turn.

actions.name: Control Undead
actions.text:
Sonechard chooses one undead creature not already
under its control that it can see within 120 feet of it. That creature, or the
creature that controls it, must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a
failed saving throw, the undead falls under Sonechard’s control and obeys
its every command.
